hydroStations.name: 8th Mile
hydroStations.humanBrief: Sits on the urban-rural transition where new housing is outrunning drain capacity. Watch this with Penrissen Road ponding reports.
hydroStations.lastEvent: Seasonal trunk-road flooding along Kuching–Serian / Penrissen.

hydroStations.name: Batu Kawa Bridge
hydroStations.note: Bridge gauge for the Batu Kawa / Desa Wira flood corridor.
hydroStations.humanBrief: The operational gauge for the RM 58.5M Batu Kawa retention programme. Rising here means Taman Desa Wira and Kampung Sinar Budi Baru are next — ~3,500 households in the inundation zone.
hydroStations.lastEvent: Recurrent inundation; DID Sarawak retention ponds targeted for 2027 completion.

hydroStations.name: Batu Kitang Telemetry
hydroStations.note: Primary upstream gauge for Kuching urban flood pre-warning.
hydroStations.humanBrief: Upstream canary for urban Kuching and the Padawan growth ring. When this gauge reads Alert, riverside kampungs along Batu Kitang are at doorstep risk and the TPPA landfill sits 800m downstream of contaminated-runoff concern.
hydroStations.lastEvent: Sg. Sarawak exceeded Warning historically; Jalan Batu Kitang flooded for ~4 hours in prior monsoon events.

hydroStations.name: Bau Bridge
hydroStations.note: Western Padawan / Bau district bridge gauge.
hydroStations.humanBrief: Western flank of Padawan. Bau PPS activations in Jan 2025 multi-district floods started from this catchment.
hydroStations.lastEvent: Jan 2025 — Kuching PPS opened for Bau evacuees.

hydroStations.name: Buso
hydroStations.humanBrief: Fills the gap between Bau Bridge and Siniawan — useful for timing crew deployment along the western roads.
hydroStations.lastEvent: Paired with Siniawan during western-catchment rises.

hydroStations.name: Desa Wira
hydroStations.note: Neighbourhood gauge inside the Padawan flood hotspot.
hydroStations.humanBrief: Sits inside the worst-hit residential pocket of Padawan. A Warning reading here is a street-level event — not a forecast.
hydroStations.lastEvent: Repeated flash floods 2024–2025; PPS activations documented in local press.

hydroStations.name: Kampung Git
hydroStations.humanBrief: Earliest basin signal — a rise here arrives at Batu Kitang 4–6 hours later. Single-lane access roads cut first.
hydroStations.lastEvent: Road to Kpg. Git cut for 2 days during 2024-01 monsoon surge.

hydroStations.name: Siniawan
hydroStations.humanBrief: Heritage town + weekend night market (~2,000 visitors). A sudden rise during market hours is a crowd-safety incident, not just a flood event.
hydroStations.lastEvent: Moderate flooding 2024-03; market evacuated, 12 shophouses affected.

hydroStations.name: Barrage
hydroStations.note: Sarawak River Barrage — estuary control structure.
hydroStations.humanBrief: Controls the tidal gate for the urban reach. A high reading here with upstream rain means the river cannot drain — Petra Jaya and the north bank feel it next.
hydroStations.lastEvent: Tidal + upstream pincer events documented at Civic Centre car park (2023).

hydroStations.name: Central Park
hydroStations.humanBrief: When Central Park rises with Maong, the flood is already inside the city grid — not an upstream story.
hydroStations.lastEvent: Surface flooding common when Maong backs up at high tide.

hydroStations.name: Kuala Maong
hydroStations.note: Urban drain mouth — backs up first when Sg. Sarawak is high.
hydroStations.humanBrief: The urban canary. At Alert, Jalan Song / Stutong junctions flood and southern Kuching gridlocks — water does not stop at the MBKS/MPP line.
hydroStations.lastEvent: Flash flood 2024-09-03; Stutong junction submerged ~3 hours.

hydroStations.name: Malihah
hydroStations.humanBrief: Watches the Matang / north-west approach — peatland drainage stress zone.
hydroStations.lastEvent: 1–2 m flood depths historically recorded in Matang Jaya lowlands.

hydroStations.name: Padungan
hydroStations.humanBrief: City-centre indicator for Main Bazaar / Padungan shop houses — tourism and commerce impact, not just housing.
hydroStations.lastEvent: High-water events along the urban waterfront.

hydroStations.name: Satok B
hydroStations.humanBrief: Heritage + market corridor. High tide + upstream rain is the classic pincer for Satok road closures.
hydroStations.affectedEstimate: Satok market and Jalan Satok commercial strip

hydroStations.name: Maong Tengah Kiri
hydroStations.humanBrief: Tracks the Maong backflow into Stutong / BDC before it reaches the Satok commercial strip.
hydroStations.lastEvent: Paired with Kuala Maong during 2024–2025 flash events.
